title: Mike Vrabel declines to discuss $250,000 fine for interaction with officials

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike Vrabel declines to discuss $250,000 fine for interaction with officials
sources.description: Last week, a report emerged that three coaches — Mike Vrabel of the Patriots, Aaron Glenn of the Jets, and Nick Sirianni of the Eagles — were fined $250,000 for interactions with officials.
